A practical way to choose is:

- **Best for Jungian depth and theory:** **Jung Platform**[2]
- **Best for guided, teacher-led spiritual shadow work:** **Awake Academy / Charlie Morley**[15]
- **Best for structured practitioner-style training:** **Shadow Work Basic Facilitator Training**[7]
- **Best for a broader personal-development style:** **ManTalks Shadow Course**[17]
- **Best for meditation-adjacent practice:** **Insight Timer course**[9]

If you want **beginner-friendly and affordable**, the Udemy offerings are also worth considering, including **“Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self,” “Shadow Work Essentials,”** and **“Do Your Own Shadow Work: Beginning to Advanced Practices.”** Udemy listings in the results also suggest these are aimed at all levels and are shorter self-paced courses.[3][13][14]

A simple recommendation:
- Start with **Insight Timer** if you want a spiritual practice angle.[9]
- Start with **Jung Platform** if you want a more psychologically grounded approach.[2]
- Start with **Awake Academy** if you want a more guided transformational course.[15]
